      recode_values(as.numeric(w1s109b), 1 ~ 22, 2 ~ 22.5, 3 ~ 23.5, 4 ~ 24)
    ),
  recode_values(as.numeric(w4s103), 1 ~ 4, 2 ~ 4.5, 3 ~ 5.5, 4 ~ 6.5, 5 ~ 7) +

    recode_values(as.numeric(w4s102), 1 ~ 22, 2 ~ 22.5, 3 ~ 23.5, 4 ~ 24.5, 5 ~ 25)
)
notes: Self-report, school term. W2 and W3: hours slept on a normal school day (上課期間平均每天), bands at midpoints, open bands at their stated bounds ('less than 5 hours' = 5, '8 hours or more' = 8). W1 and W4: usual term-time wake time minus bedtime (W1 junior-college form w1s109b), closed bands at midpoints, open bands at their bounds (before 9 pm 21:00, before 10 pm 22:00, midnight or later 00:00, 1 am or later 01:00, before 4 am 04:00, 7 am or later 07:00); 'it depends' NA. Partial: banded, and bed-to-wake time at W1 and W4.
School-term items only; no usual-night value; see hlth_sleep_wd.
